layouts.name: Millbrook Hill Route Full
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The full hill-route configuration includes the long western return, central hill limb and outer eastern return. The manufacturer driving-course plan identifies the Hill Route separately from the mile straight, bowl, handling and city circuits; the Millbrook operator brochure identifies its three sections. Independent 2020-2021 Environment Agency one-metre intensity survey confirms the physical pavement and exact current OSM source-node joins. The independently measured 3,589.8 m remains unchanged versus the supplied 3,592 m. Northern facility access, eastern inner bypasses, junction triangles and off-road trails are excluded. The advertised 6.5 km facility extent is not this timed lap. Historical alignment, direction and lane placement remain draft. No diagram coordinates, private geometry, timing coordinates or length fitting determine the trace. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 3589.8 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
